reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as a business plan promising instant and 100% payouts in exchange for a 10 BUSD entry payment and recruitment of additional participants. It directs viewers into x3/x4 referral structures where earnings depend on referred people and presents unlimited recycling as a benefit. The material is promotional rather than reporting or criticizing the scheme.

you have to make a team as soon as you have referred one person, then it will be a minimum 5 busd
as soon as you do a report to another person by default you get 100 percent payment within a second
as soon as you refer a third person because your structure is full, you do not have to invest money again on your structure. So by default this reinvestment happens
the sixth will go to the upline

opening.argument: Judge, the payout language is forceful, but the speaker does not give a date by which any participant will earn. In discussing the larger returns, he says there is no time limit on when they will come and ties them to working with the plan. The presentation also spends substantial time discussing cryptocurrency's potential and adoption. Those qualifications do not make the claims reliable, but they matter when deciding whether this is a guaranteed-return solicitation rather than financial commentary with overstated enthusiasm.

citations.quote: there is no limit when it will come, there is no time limit when it will come, but it will come if you are working with the right plan
There is such a potential in cryptocurrency so much potensial
FORSAGE BUSD 100% Decentralized Plan Full Review in Hindi/ Business Plan #cryptocurrency

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies entry, referrals and a payment claim, but those excerpts do not establish a promised date or amount of total profit for a viewer. The speaker expressly leaves the timing open. That does not erase the referral structure; it limits what can be inferred from the payout language alone.

citations.quote: there is no limit when it will come, there is no time limit when it will come

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Leaving the timing open is not a meaningful risk warning: the same sentence says payment 'will come.' More importantly, the case does not depend on a dated profit forecast. The speaker explains an entry payment, tells viewers to make a team, and describes payments triggered by referrals. Those are the central claims the defense's uncertainty argument does not answer.

citations.quote: but it will come if you are working with the right plan
10 BUSD, you can join
you have to make a team as soon as you have referred one person, then it will be a minimum 5 busd

opening.argument: Judge, the title calls this a full review, and the speaker builds an explanation before reaching the plan: he asks what cryptocurrency is, describes blockchain as a transaction ledger, then walks through the x3 structure and what happens when its positions fill. Explaining a mechanism, including its referral payments, is not by itself proof that a viewer is being directed to participate. Read the payout passages in that instructional sequence, rather than treating every described step as an instruction to join.

citations.quote: Full Review in Hindi/ Business Plan
But what is cryptocurrency?
same way cryptocurrency is used to calculate the transaction, digital laser is used, which is called blockchain technology
First of all, let's talk about X3, you see in X3, here is the structure of these three people work?

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution accurately quotes the entry price and referral sequence, but those details are also precisely what an operational review would need to explain. Its excerpts establish the mechanism more clearly than they establish that the speaker asked this particular audience to pay or sign up. The title's 'Full Review' wording and the preceding technology explanation deserve weight when assessing the video's purpose.

citations.quote: FORSAGE BUSD 100% Decentralized Plan Full Review in Hindi/ Business Plan #cryptocurrency
What is blockchain technology?

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A review title and introductory definitions do not neutralize the speaker's directions. He says viewers can join for 10 BUSD, tells them they have to make a team, and presents a referred person's payment as an immediate benefit. The explanation is of how to participate and earn through the referral structure, not a detached technology demonstration.

citations.quote: 10 BUSD, you can join
you have to make a team as soon as you have referred one person, then it will be a minimum 5 busd
as soon as you do a report to another person by default you get 100 percent payment within a second

opening.argument: Judge, referrals can also be part of an ordinary promotion. The speaker calls the initial payment a joining amount and describes a direct sponsor payment for referring someone. He also says a participant can choose whether to pursue the twelve levels. The excerpts show a team structure and an upline, but do not show a demand for credentials or establish that every participant must recruit to enter. Those missing elements do not validate the offer; they caution against treating the presence of a referral payment alone as conclusive.

citations.quote: its joining amount is that you joining amount is 10 BUSD, you can join
it is also called referral income it is also called direct sponsor income
There is no condition to take these labels, if you want, you can achieve 12-12 labels from your investment

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that a third referral cycles to an upline; that is stronger evidence than a single referral bonus. Still, the quoted sequence describes where payments go within the structure, not whether the speaker has shown an external loss or asked viewers for account credentials. The judge should distinguish the observed mechanics from harms that have not been demonstrated here.

citations.quote: So by default this reinvestment happens and this goes to your immediate
the sixth will go to the upline

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The concern is not a referral reward in isolation, and credential theft or a demonstrated loss is not necessary to recognize this mechanism. Entry buys positions in x3 and x4; the speaker tells participants to make a team, describes payments from successive referrals, and routes later positions to an upline. The defense's ordinary-promotion analogy leaves that tiered cycle unexplained.
